dedupe_keys.name: bornes de recharge pour voitures electriques

description: Bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques is a dataset listed in Gers-OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département du Gers. Données importées depuis le site data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Gers. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité, Développement durable. Its keywords are bornes, électriques. The portal shows 401 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gers-fr-portal.
